problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: Electrical network method for higher-dim dissections.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Proved 3 lemmas (exists_smaller_cube, descent_chains_from_coverage, dissection_of_cubes_from_coverage). Reduced sorry structure: old 2 sorries replaced by 2 cleaner sorries. New direct proof path avoids chain construction.
builtItems: Assessment: 2 actual sorries at lines 390, 422 of DissectionOfCubesOQ03.lean
Architecture: proves all_different_implies_long_chains from coverage (replacing parent axiom)
Proved descent_chains_from_coverage from exfalso + global_min contradiction (~line 478)
insights: Only 2 actual sorries (metadata claimed 8 — 6 are in comments)
smallest_above_is_smaller: if c is smallest on floor, cube above interior of top face is smaller
Key geometric argument: taller neighbors confine what can sit above the smallest cube
descent_chains_from_coverage follows by induction once smallest_above_is_smaller is proved
This eliminates the all_different_implies_long_chains_axiom from the parent file
The problem title (electrical network method) refers to OQ05 but sorries are in OQ03
exists_smaller_cube derives base axiom from smallest_above_is_smaller via floor minimum + midpoint witness
descent_chains_from_coverage proved by deriving contradiction from global min + exists_smaller_cube (exfalso)
dissection_of_cubes_from_coverage now has direct proof: global min + exists_smaller_cube, no chains needed
global_min_not_reaching_top is the new well-scoped sorry: global minimum cube has z + side < 1
1-cube dissection edge case: allDifferentSizes is vacuously true, theorem statement is technically false for card=1
nextSteps: Prove global_min_not_reaching_top: for bottom-floor mins, use filling argument (side=1 only cube). For non-bottom mins, use coverage + interior-disjointness below c_min
Prove smallest_above_is_smaller: formalize confinement using interiorDisjoint with floor neighbors
